name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos Project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The company is in the development stage, having completed an updated NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate in 2026 and advancing a definitive feasibility study. AbraSilver also holds an earn-in and joint venture option on the La Coipita project in San Juan province alongside Teck.
